==Skin Trivia==
*The original {{Color|Premium|Mint Choco}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/96554028/profile/ impjelly].
*The concept model for the '''Freezer''' was made by a community member.
*The {{Color|Other|IcyTea}} skin is based on Roblox developer and YouTuber [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvKdsA4I2oppDCVJmpffTiw IcyTea].
*The original {{Color|Other|IcyTea}} icon used its Level 3 appearance, without the gloves.
*The '''Freezer''' used to share its upgrade icons with the [[Frost Blaster]].
*The {{Color|Other|Foam}} skin looks remarkably similar to the [[Breaker]] enemy, having a similar color scheme and stitch pattern on its torso.
*Oddly, on Level 1 upgrade icon, the '''Freezer''' uses its Level 2 appearance, having light blue fur around its neck and a beanie.
*The '''Freezer's''' cryo rifle may have been based on the Kriss Vector.

===Roblox Catalog===
*The second, third and fourth versions of the Level 5 Default '''Freezer''' winter hood is the {{RLinkC|39247441|Subarctic Commando}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The appearance of the first version Default skin's cryogun and second version Level 0-3 Default skin's cryogun was most likely based on the {{RLinkC|42845853|Super Freeze Ray 2011}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
*The face used by the first and second version of the {{Color|Other|IcyTea}} skin is the {{RLinkC|26619096|Sick Day}} face from the Roblox catalog.
*The {{Color|Krampus|Cryptid}} skin's hood was uploaded to the Roblox catalog as the {{RLinkC|15688153148|Cryptid Hood}} UGC accessory.
